description: A low glazed drum between two curved wings, three floors, and the ground rent on it is one credit a year for a hundred and fifty years — which is a joke the developer made in a contract and will be honouring until long after everyone involved is dead. It is let to the estate's own security contractor. The door on the Cowslip Rise side is a glass one in a chrome frame with a keypad beside it that is not switched on, and there is a light burning behind the drum glazing at every hour of the day and night.
